reasons: Only explicitly admitted immutable models/operators and checked absolute budgets have certificate authority.
A represented-stage target certificate is not an ODE truncation certificate.
New native checks are bounded discriminating fixtures, not a declaration of arbitrary workload resource adequacy.
Empirical reference uncertainty and allocator-instrumented timings do not constitute full deployment performance evidence.

promotion_prerequisites.action: Declare exact deployment model/operator, frame, initial uncertainty, grid/horizon/output mesh, norm and unchanged tolerance.
Compile exact source and run specified changed-scope checks; preserve failures and source/config identities.
Run actual target-sized workload and demonstrate budget success or typed bounded refusal and memory/resource ceilings.
For speed promotion, compare matched achieved error and outputs with setup/certification/rejections/allocations and independent timing uncertainty included.

historical_campaign_policy: Reused after one adversarial audit when source and premises remain applicable; failed attempts and old allocator environment failures preserved rather than rewritten.
